rows.grounds: genitive singular of rudra; deity name in cosmological context
compound: sṛṣṭi-saṃhāra-kartuḥ (gen., creator and destroyer) + brahmāṇḍa-vartmani (loc., on the path/course of the universe)
bahuvrīhi compound: dīkṣā-jñāna-vihīnāḥ (nom. pl. masc., lacking initiation and knowledge)
compound: liṅga-ārādhana-tatparāḥ (nom. pl. masc., intent on worship of the liṅga)
